cross_source_union_adds.statement: The aggregate combines general crystal and electronic records from COD, Materials Project, NOMAD, AFLOW, and other qualified sources with MaterialsGalaxy/Materiae source-native topology records for the same formula.

MaterialsGalaxy contributes exact R-3m and Pnma topology labels under no-SOC and SOC request contexts, while the broader aggregate supplies separately attributed structural and scalar electronic context rather than an independent topology verdict.

material_landscape.researcher_use: Use the general cross-source landscape to identify candidate phases and electronic context, then inspect the two preregistered MaterialsGalaxy records as source-native SOC-conditioned reports without treating them as independently verified topology.
material_landscape.external_handoff: Independent validation requires phase-compatible DFT and Wannier-based workflows such as WannierTools to recompute invariants and surface states; MatRouter exposes no topology validator and no unrelated lightweight method substitutes for that calculation.

rq3_method_applicability.reason: MatRouter exposes no general explicit topology-validation method; this case evaluates exact source-native SOC-conditioned topology acquisition only.

scientific_question: What source-native SOC-conditioned topology data does MaterialsGalaxy report for Bi2Se3, and how do other qualified structural and electronic records broaden the physical context without becoming a universal topology verdict?

retrieval_strategy: RQ1 and RQ2 share one authoritative all_qualified + exhaust_upstream aggregate_source_records call. MatRouter retains its bounded ordered_parallel_map fan-out (at most eight independent source routes), stable route-order aggregation, and sequential pagination within each source. The evaluation supplies no records, pages, elapsed-time, normalized-byte, or Bundle-closure engineering ceiling overrides; the installed product release owns those defaults and every effective value and typed stop remains auditable in the captured requirement, run capacity, executions, and RecordCompleteness. RQ1 reports coverage and closure while RQ2 maps source contributions and scientific context from the same source-record items. Exact follow-up enriches only preregistered mg-35598 and mg-2145449 when present in the aggregate, binds their original acquisition and record reference, issues no second source search, and adds no topology validator.
context_differences: Formula identity does not prove the same crystal phase across sources.
Source-native topology labels depend on the source definition, method, SOC setting, and exact record.
MaterialsGalaxy reports distinct R-3m and Pnma records for the same formula; their no-SOC/SOC comparison is a descriptive view of existing artifacts, not new evidence.
Structural, scalar electronic, and topology records can be complementary while remaining non-comparable.
allowed_statement: State that MaterialsGalaxy reports each captured topology class and indicator under its exact record, source-native structure identity, and SOC context. Present the R-3m/Pnma by no-SOC/SOC table only as a deterministic descriptive view of those same Bundle artifacts, alongside separately attributed evidence from other qualified source routes.
prohibited_statement: Do not claim MatRouter recomputed topology invariants or surface states or independently validated topology classifications, promote one source label to universal truth, treat the derived comparison table as new evidence, infer trivial topology from missing artifacts, or merge records solely by Bi2Se3 formula.
missing_evidence: Missing SOC, method, phase, invariant, or surface-state context remains unknown rather than negative evidence.
No cross-source structure matching was executed, so cross-source phase equivalence remains unresolved.

The all-qualified aggregate attempts every parsed qualified route, but fair Bundle-capacity sharing or a safety ceiling can yield typed truncation or upstream-total-unknown results and prevents an all-upstream-records claim.
next_action: Select phase-compatible exact inputs, then hand off independent topology-invariant and surface-state validation to external DFT and Wannier-based workflows such as WannierTools; cross-source phase matching remains a separately declared analysis.
